scope: integrations (jira, m365, radius, hris) + all other controllers reading actor-ish fields (actorId/performedBy/changedBy/requestedBy/createdBy/resolvedBy/approvedBy) from @Body()/dto/@Query/@Headers rather than req.principal
method: Grepped every *.controller.ts for actor-ish field references; isolated the 6 that source the actor from body/request/dto (vs the ~40 that source from req.principal); traced each into its service/repo to confirm whether the body value lands in a DB audit/author column via Prisma create/update.

spoofable.flow: controller passes body.actorId -> TerminateEmployeeService.execute({ actorId: body.actorId }). Handler NEVER reads req.principal (sibling deactivate handler one method up DOES correctly use req.principal).
dbColumnsPersisted: ProjectPositionFillHistory.changedByPersonId — src/modules/project-positions/application/transition-project-position-fill.service.ts:138 (RELEASED transition per active fill) tx.projectPositionFillHistory.create({ data: { changedByPersonId: command.actorId } })
spoofable.notPersistedToDb: auditLogger.record({ actorId: command.actorId }) goes to InMemoryAuditLogStore (not Prisma) — not a DB sink, but the two DB sinks above are.
spoofable.severity: HIGH — caller controls who terminate is attributed to in the persisted employee activity ledger and the position fill-history audit trail.

spoofable.flow: controller passes request.actorId -> AssignProjectTeamService.execute({ actorId: request.actorId }). Handler NEVER reads req.principal.
dbColumnsPersisted: ProjectPositionFillHistory.changedByPersonId — two transitions (PROPOSED, BOOKED) per created assignment, transition-project-position-fill.service.ts:138
spoofable.severity: HIGH — caller controls the create/update author + fill-history changedBy on every position created by the team expansion.

sound.reason: No @Body() actor field; audit records hardcode actorId: null and go to InMemoryAuditLogStore. No client-controlled actor persisted.
actorId hardcoded null; only Prisma access in module is read-only (m365-directory-reconciliation-query.service findMany). No body actor.
actorId hardcoded null in all audit records; no body actor field.
@Body() is UpdateHrisConfigRequestDto (config only, no actor field); no DB author column written from body.

resolvedBy/suppressedBy come from body (ResolveExceptionRequestDto.resolvedBy / SuppressExceptionRequestDto.suppressedBy) BUT the sink is ExceptionResolutionStore — a pure in-memory Map (exception-resolution.store.ts). No Prisma persistence, so not a DB audit-column spoof. (Data-integrity smell: body-supplied resolvedBy, but out of scope for DB-persisted actor spoofing.)

body.createdByPersonId passed to webhookService.create, but the bound service is InMemoryWebhookService (admin.module.ts:44) — no Prisma model (webhook service has no DB table per project rules). Not a DB spoof.

body.requestedByPersonId is persisted to ProjectPosition.requestedByPersonId (a business demand field), but the CANONICAL audit columns createdByPersonId/updatedByPersonId are sourced from actorId = req.principal (controller line 209). Body field is not the canonical actor -> SOUND per sweep criteria.

requesterPersonId is overridden with principal: { ...dto, requesterPersonId: actorId ?? null } where actorId = httpRequest.principal?.personId. Spread-then-override means any client value is clobbered by principal. SOUND.

evidence: person-directory.controller.ts:102 actorId: body.actorId -> TerminateEmployeeService -> employee-activity.service.ts:33 prisma.employeeActivityEvent.create({data:{actorId}}) AND transition-project-position-fill.service.ts:138 changedByPersonId: command.actorId. projects.controller.ts:263 actorId: request.actorId -> assign-project-team.service.ts -> create-project-position.service.ts:124 createdByPersonId + transition-project-position-fill.service.ts:138. Both handlers never read req.principal. By contrast jira/m365/radius/hris controllers hardcode actorId:null and have no body actor field; exceptions resolvedBy/suppressedBy + admin webhook createdByPersonId hit in-memory stores (not Prisma); project-positions requestedByPersonId and change-request requesterPersonId are non-canonical/principal-overridden.
